thread:
Leah Park: Heads up 00. We need to finalize the observability GA acceptance criteria for Console this week. Focus areas: dashboards, trace hooking, cost rollups, and error triage UX.
Diego Alvarez: I'll second that. From customer interviews: they want a simple "cost hotspots" view + the ability to click into traces for slow/expensive requests.
Noah Reed: Can we make cost hotspots compute at query time over aggregates to avoid per-request writes? Probably use daily rollups keyed by (customer, model, route).
Leah Park: Yes, daily rollups for GA is fine. MVP should not store per-token logs. We'll rely on sampled token emissions.
Diego Alvarez: UX note: show relative delta vs baseline period (7d). Also highlight top 5 routes by cost growth.
Noah Reed: Trace hook design: a lightweight webhook that sends span metadata + a signed url to fetch full span if requested. That reduces backend storage on initial ingest.
monitor-bot: New alert created: obs.slo_burn_rate > 0.05 for 10m -> paging oncall
Leah Park: Good. For error analytics: group by top-level error class (transport, model, user) and present sample stack or error payload. Need a "mark as root cause" action for SREs.
Diego Alvarez: Data retention proposal: full spans 7d, aggregated metrics 180d. Exports: CSV export + API endpoint for programmatic pulls.
Noah Reed: Infra ask: need an opt-in for longer retention and an export job that can TTL to object storage.
Leah Park: Acceptance criteria draft:
- Overview dashboard with latency/cost/errors across models & routes
- Cost Hotspots with 7d delta and top 5 routes
- Trace hook implementation + signed fetch path for full spans
- Error groups w/ link to traces + mark root cause action
- Alerts for SLO burn and error spike
- Retention policy documented (7d full spans, 180d aggregates)
- CSV/API export for cost data
Diego Alvarez: Sounds reasonable. What's the GA date?
Leah Park: Aiming for 2024-12-12 ship to production. Need PRD and implementation plan by EOW.
Noah Reed: I'll add infra estimates to the PRD.
Leah Park: Thanks all. Please add any missing acceptance items in the PRD comments.
